Home / Scope and pricing

NO SURPRISES IN THE SCOPE

Know what you are buying.
Before work begins.

Prices and delivery availability are not yet finalised. The proposed approach is a written quotation for a defined scope, not an unexplained headline price.

Compare the proposed starting points
ReviewPrimary outputQuotation basis
One-off Practice Security ReviewEvidence-labelled report and prioritised action planBronze, Silver or Gold scope; written project quotation based on named systems, checks and handover
Optional monthly Practice Security CareAgreed recurring checks, monthly report and action trackingSeparately agreed monthly fee, included work, hours and contract terms

Bronze, Silver and Gold describe the proposed depth of a one-off review. They do not commit you to monthly care. No tier prices have been approved. Compare the three scope options.

What should be in your quote?

  • Named systems, account and device limits.
  • Delivery owner, timing and customer responsibilities.
  • Deliverables, exclusions and access required.
  • Total in GBP, VAT treatment and payment terms.
  • Any third-party charges or licensing dependencies.
  • Terms for additional work and optional follow-up.

What changes the scope?

More accounts, multiple practitioners, complex integrations or a need for hands-on implementation may require a different scope. Additional work should be approved before it begins.

Advice, remediation, certification, specialist testing and ongoing monitoring are different services. They should never be treated as interchangeable line items.

No automatic subscription.

The one-off review stands alone. Monthly care is a separate, optional choice and never starts automatically. Any recurring arrangement would require its own agreed work, limits, support availability and cancellation terms. Insurance and certification are not included in the planned packages.
